title: Count actual Lean axiom queries outside comments and strings
head: f839ed0aca28280aea47c724937a2da04e5b7bcd
body:
The shared live Lean axiom checker counts #print lines inside comments and string literals. A concrete Lean 4.34.1 fixture with a commented-out query and an IO.println report for a nonexistent declaration currently receives PASS 1. Conversely, a valid query containing an inline Lean comment is omitted, and explanatory commented queries can reject a valid audit.

Mask nested block comments, line comments and ordinary string literals before collecting distinct query names. Parse complete multiline dependency reports and trim each comma-separated axiom; retain strict checks for missing/extra/duplicate declarations, malformed reports, custom axioms, sorryAx and compiler failure. Existing audit command inventories remain identical. The script now exposes small importable scanner/report functions behind its unchanged CLI.

Validation on Windows CPython 3.12.14 with Lean 4.34.1 (5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52): the old helper falsely accepts the forged-comment fixture and rejects the valid commented fixture. All 4 new test methods pass, including actual lake env lean executions for the valid comment/string fixture, forged-output rejection, genuine multiline output from 12 custom axioms, and a sorryAx control. The three existing AuditAll command lists are unchanged. Synthetic multiline standard-axiom reports also pass; the actual allowed-axiom output observed here was single-line. No complete existing project rebuild is claimed.

Reproduce with LEAN_AUDIT_BIN pointing to a Lean distribution's bin directory, then python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_lean_axiom_audit_parser.py -v. Without that explicit runtime, pure parser/inventory tests run and the live integration test is skipped. git diff --check passes.

Scope: a bounded source/report parser repair, not a complete Lean parser or authentication of arbitrary hostile elaborators and loggers. Ordinary strings and nested comments are handled; Lean compilation and source review remain trust boundaries. No theorem, scientific source or selected frontier changes.

Task selection: recursive-interfaces seed 42696d2e47cdaca9c2eee27f3b1deb17, changed to this concrete live-verifier boundary. Canonical main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority revision 4; live PR/Discussion and local overlap checks found no shared-helper repair. Related predecessor: WeberChen8128's pr236-independent-command-audit independently handles comments and multiline recorded logs for a different historical corpus; it does not repair this live helper. Existing helper authors and that prior audit retain credit. New work by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
